verdict.rationale: Render documents ephemeral previews of the entire application architecture for every change, plus environment isolation that keeps non-production environments from reaching production services. Together these give real sandbox isolation, not just a dry-run. It also offers short-lived service instances for running commands without connecting to production. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how preview environments handle datastores and data seeding, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
Prevent non-production environments from accessing production services.
You can start a short-lived instance of your service to inspect its runtime or run one-off commands without connecting to production.
